_comment: Ollama config for desktop (native Vulkan; ROCm is unavailable on gfx1030). Copy to config.json and adjust.
_firewall_note: Ensure Windows inbound firewall rule allows TCP 11434 for LAN access from server.
_env_note: Also set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 as environment variable for reliability.
_context_note: Per-model context is baked via Modelfile num_ctx by desktop/scripts/startup.ps1 (see its $contextModels), not via OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH - the env var is a single global default and is honoured on Windows since Ollama 0.34.0. Point OpenCode at the baked tag (e.g. deepseek-r1-16k) and keep limit.context in opencode.jsonc in sync with the bake.
